verdict.rationale: The evidence does not show that Sales Cloud lets a user issue scoped or least-privilege API credentials (OAuth scopes, connected-app tokens, per-agent keys) to an agent. The only related item describes admin attribute-based (ABAC) data-access policies that cover AI agents. That is an adjacent access-control feature, not credential issuance, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Admins can control who sees what data and when, from humans to AI agents, by enforcing custom attribute-based (ABAC) access policies.
